subject: changing the default blue/white color of selected element in radioButtons/checkbox input

messages.author: 605c14114b1f1179
messages.subject: changing the default blue/white color of selected element in radioButtons/checkbox input
parts:
Hello,

Whenever, one choose the radioButtons, the (default) selected option has white dot and blue surrounding (to indicate that it's chosen). I was wondering if anyone knew how to change these default colors (ideally using the class attribute and basic CSS).

Thanks in advance

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: changing the default blue/white color of selected element in radioButtons/checkbox input
parts:
It's actually up to your browser how those are presented. It's possible to customize but kind of a pain, you have to use hacky workarounds involving custom PNG files, AFAIK.

https://www.google.com/search?client=ubuntu&channel=fs&q=input+radio+css&ie=utf-8&oe=utf-8
